## Documentation as Institutional Memory

This documentation serves as a **Cognitive Build Ledger** - a complete longitudinal record of the system's evolution:

- **693 session handoffs** preserve decisions, bugs, fixes, and lessons learned
- **71 audits** document system reality vs. expectations
- **Design docs** capture architectural intent and the "why"
- Any AI agent can resume work without loss of context

**Philosophy:** Document while thinking, not after building.
